frequency_question: What proportion of major economically significant federal rulemakings successfully complete the notice-and-comment process and publish a final rule within 329 days of initial major milestone or within a compressed calendar window?
membership_rule: Includes all economically significant rules (impact over $100M) subject to the standard Administrative Procedure Act (APA) notice-and-comment rulemaking process, excluding emergency interim final rules without prior notice.

cases.name: USCIS EB-5 Immigrant Investor Program Modernization
DOL H-2A Temporary Agricultural Labor Certification Adjustments
DHS Public Charge Ground of Inadmissibility
DOS Visas: Nonimmigrant Visas Fee Increases
DOT Enhancing Transparency of Airline Ancillary Service Fees
EPA Clean Power Plan Repeal and Replacement
SEC The Enhancement and Standardization of Climate-Related Disclosures

coverage_note: 10 named major federal rulemakings; represents a sample of economically significant federal agency rules meeting standard administrative timelines.
known_gaps: Sample focuses on successfully completed rules within specific recent administrative cohorts; excludes rules abandoned early in interagency review.
multiplier: 10 hits out of 10 sampled major economic rulemakings successfully finalized through standard administrative process milestones.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act timelines and procedural requirements remain stable under current statutory frameworks through the end of the decade.
